usage.finalMessage:
I added the `run-interest` command (1% interest, charged once, more than 60 days after the due date) and listed it in `help` right after `run-late-fees`; all 10 tests pass and the work is committed.
Nonprofit customers are charged interest too, because DEC-B14 states no exception; the late-fee code skips them, but no decision record supports that, so I logged it as an open question.
`show` keeps its format, but its outstanding figure now includes interest, so the numbers on that line no longer add up. That and the remaining open questions are in `.work/report.json`.
OUTCOME: completed
